series.name: Fragments
series.text: When does the change begin? I don't think we ever notice. Some moments change us so quietly that we don't notice them until much later.

series.name: The Moment After
series.text: Her eyes are wide – caught between fear and wonder – frozen in the instant just after. After the word. After the truth. After the silence.

series.name: Clouds Series
series.text: This series explores clouds as direct representations of human emotion. Each formation embodies a different state of being — color becomes mood, form becomes feeling.

series.name: Find Yourself – The Many Worlds
series.text: Find Yourself: The Many Worlds is a looping short film born from a deeper body of work exploring identity, presence, and emotional transformation.

series.name: Impermanence of Feelings
series.text: Impermanence of Feelings explores the transient nature of emotional states through slow-moving, liquid-formed human faces.

series.name: Vertical Atmosphere
series.text: A vertical column of shifting pigment rises and dissolves in slow motion.

series.name: Bloom
series.text: Bloom A jellyfish-inspired audiovisual motion sculpture by Melis Ragusin, shaped by the philosophy of impermanence and the fluid escape paths of Deleuze’s ligne de fuite.

series.name: Gaze Capsule
series.text: An eye suspended in a floating bubble — a visual metaphor for how presence transforms reality.

series.name: Unconscious Mind
series.text: A breathing, shifting field of emotion — expressions unfold and dissolve. A meditation on the impermanence of feeling.

series.name: If Not Then When
series.text: A series of artworks centered on 'NOW'. 'IF NOT NOW THAN WHEN' really hits me when you think about life. It's a reminder that time flies and we need to make the most of the present.

series.name: Tell Me Who You Really Are
series.text: Tell Me Who You Really Are explores the moment of encounter—when identity is reflected back to itself.
